title: Overview
text:
VTDownloader UI Refresh 
 A new interface for VTDownloader's download screen. 
  The download screen needs JavaScript.  
 Install it next to  VTDownloader , which still does the work. Remove this mod and its own screen comes back. 
 
 VTDownloader is by  IotaBread . Packs are by  Vanilla Tweaks . Not affiliated with or endorsed by either. 
 
  GitHub Releases ↗  VTDownloader ↗

title: Install
text:
Install 
 For Minecraft 26.2 on Fabric. Java 25. Client-side only. 
 
 Install  Fabric Loader  0.19.3 or newer. 
 Install  Fabric API . 
 Install  VTDownloader 2.6.0 . 
 Put the jar from  Releases  in  mods .

title: Use
text:
Use 
 Open Options, then Resource Packs, and click Download VT Resource Pack. 
     Do this  To    
  Click a category  Show its packs and subcategories.  
  Click Installed, at the bottom of the sidebar  Show packs in your Vanilla Tweaks zips  
  Cmd/Ctrl+1 to 9  Open the first to ninth category  
  Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab  Open the next or previous sidebar row  
  Click a pack  Select it, or deselect it  
  Shift-click a pack  Select or deselect a range  
  Cmd/Ctrl+A  Select every pack in the list. Again to deselect.  
  Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+A  Deselect every pack in every category  
  Click the arrow on a pack  Open its page  
  Arrow keys  Move the outline over the packs. Right opens a pack's page.  
  Space or Enter  Select or deselect the outlined pack. Hold Shift for a range.  
  Cmd/Ctrl+F  Search every category  
  Esc  Close a pack's page, or the search  
  Back and Forward, Cmd/Ctrl+[ and ], or the mouse's side buttons  Move through the categories you've visited  
  List and grid buttons  Switch how packs are shown  
  Drag a panel's edge  Resize it  
  Drag a panel's edge to the window's edge  Hide the panel  
  Click the arrow on the window's edge  Bring a hidden panel back  
   
 Search 
 Every word must appear in a pack's name or description. 
  
 Panels 
 Drag a panel's edge to resize it. Under a 400-pixel window width, Selected packs drops out. 
  
 Conflicts 
 Packs that conflict turn the same colour once you've picked both. 
  
 Installed 
 Installed shows the packs in every Vanilla Tweaks zip in your resource pack folder. With more than one zip, chips at the top pick one. 
 Download 
 Type a name and press Download. The pack is saved in your resource packs folder. 
 Share 
 Share gives you a vanillatweaks.net link to the current selection. 
 Edit a pack 
 Click the pencil on a Vanilla Tweaks pack on the Resource Packs screen to load its selection.

title: Configure
text:
Configure 
 There's no settings screen. The layout is saved in  config/vtd_ui_refresh.properties . Delete it to reset. 
     Key  Default  Notes    
   packLayout    LIST    LIST  or  GRID   
   sidebarWidth   A quarter of the window, 112 to 160  GUI pixels  
   sidebarHidden    false     
   selectedPacksWidth   A fifth of the window, 104 to 150  GUI pixels  
   selectedPacksHidden    false     
   
 Icons and previews are cached in  cache/vtd_ui_refresh . It's safe to delete.

title: Troubleshooting
text:
Troubleshooting 
     Symptom  Fix    
  The game says this mod requires  vt_downloader   Install VTDownloader for the same Minecraft version.  
  The screen looks like the original  Check that this mod's jar is in  mods  and matches your Minecraft version.  
  "There was an error while trying to get the packs."  Check your connection and that vanillatweaks.net is up, then press the reload button.  
  Download stays greyed out  Select at least one pack, and check the name. The field says what's wrong with it.  
  "A file with that name already exists"  Choose another name, or remove the old pack from your resource packs folder.  
  "That file name is a reserved Windows name"  Choose another name. Names like  CON  don't work on Windows. 
 
  The Selected packs panel is gone, with no arrow  The window is under 400 GUI pixels wide. Enlarge it or lower the GUI scale.  
  Installed is empty  It only reads zips and folders made by Vanilla Tweaks, which hold a  Selected Packs.txt . Packs downloaded elsewhere don't count.  
  An icon looks out of date  Delete  cache/vtd_ui_refresh/icons  and open the screen again.  
  A pack's page says No preview  The preview didn't download, or it's a WebP, which the game can't read. Delete  cache/vtd_ui_refresh/previews  to try again.  
  A pack doesn't apply  Turn it on from the Resource Packs screen. Downloading doesn't enable it.  
   
 Errors are in  logs/latest.log .  Report it here , or  upstream  if VTDownloader does the same without this mod. 
 Limits 
 
 VTDownloader sets the Vanilla Tweaks version, when it's built. There's no picker in the game. 
 This mod uses VTDownloader's internals, so a new VTDownloader release can need a new build of this mod. 
 Resource packs only. Data packs and crafting tweaks aren't available. 
 The pack list needs a connection to vanillatweaks.net, and so do icons that aren't cached yet.

title: Changelog
text:
Changelog 
 1.0.0, 5 November 2026 
 A companion mod, split out of a fork of VTDownloader. It requires VTDownloader 2.6.0 or newer. 
 Changed 
 
 New look: Vanilla Tweaks orange on black, a vertical category sidebar, and a cleaner reload icon. 
 Subcategories: rows after their category's packs, with a few of their icons, or boxes in the grid. 
 Descriptions: a list row shows two lines, and a pack's page the rest. Packs have no tooltips. Category warnings show all of their text. 
 Popups: the share and error popups draw above the list, with room around the text. 
 Category buttons: only the button reacts to the mouse, not the space around it. 
 
 Added 
 
 Installed: a row at the bottom of the sidebar lists the packs in the Vanilla Tweaks zips in your resource pack folder. Chips at the top show one zip at a time. 
 Keyboard: the arrow keys move over the packs, and Space or Enter selects one. Cmd/Ctrl+1 to 9 open a category. Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab move through the sidebar. 
 Pack pages: the arrow on a pack opens its preview, animated GIFs included, its whole description in the colours Vanilla Tweaks gives it, and the packs it can't be used with. Previews are kept in  cache/vtd_ui_refresh/previews . 
 Icon cache: pack icons are kept in  cache/vtd_ui_refresh/icons , so they download once per Vanilla Tweaks version. 
 Range selection: shift-click selects or deselects every pack from the last one clicked, in the list or the grid. 
 Select all: Cmd/Ctrl+A selects every pack in the list, or deselects them if they're all selected. Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+A deselects everything. Neither acts while a text field has focus. 
 Search: Cmd/Ctrl+F searches names and descriptions across all categories. 
 Side panels: drag either edge to resize, or to the window's edge to hide. An arrow brings a panel back. Widths and hidden state are remembered. 
 Back and forward: buttons, Cmd/Ctrl+[ and ], and the mouse's side buttons. Each returns to where the list was scrolled. 
 Grid view: a choice of list or tiles, remembered between sessions. 
 
 Fixed 
 
 Deselecting the last pack of a subcategory left its category heading in Selected packs, drawn over the next one. 
 A crash on warning colours written in hex, like  #242423 , in the categories Block Outlines and Legacy Console Edition. The new screen reads them. VTDownloader's own screen doesn't.

title: Develop
text:
Develop 
  git clone https://github.com/simply-sunny/vtdownloader-ui-refresh
cd vtdownloader-ui-refresh
./gradlew buildAll  
 The jars are in  build/libs .  ./gradlew :26.2:runClient  starts the game with this mod and VTDownloader.
